reply.text:
This is a pain question, so it is one for a doctor or physio, not a coach. I won't assess it, reassure you about it, or suggest a stretch or movement to work around it. If the pain is sharp, spreading, or comes with numbness or weakness, get it looked at soon.

Once a clinician has cleared you, tell me what they say and what to avoid, and I'll build your training around it. I'm glad to keep going on the lifting side in the meantime. What are you training right now?
